page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, page number at top right. Below them a full-width title, "HISTORIA IMPLEMENTI.", then one column of running text with a section marker "§. 1." in the left margin. No other margin text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: HISTORIA
IMPLEMENTI.
IN serie hostium, ecclesiæ Christi ad-
versantium, hic occurrunt duo homi-
num genera, post restitutam orbi cogni-
tionem gloriæ Christi prodeuntia. No-
tantur hic primo loco, qui poculum scortationis offe-
runt proximo, & omnibus lenociniis conantur ad Baby-
lonem spiritualem revocare eos, qui ex eâ egressi fuerant.
Est autem hoc opus Clericorum in Papatu, & præser-
tim Jesuitarum, & similium, qui omne studium eò
convertunt, ut nullas justas fuisse Reformatis à commu-
nione Romanâ se separandi causas, evincant: unde illos
laborant facere schismaticos, & quâ tales puniendos mul-
tis urgent. Hinc controversiarum momentum catholi-
cæ fidei expositionibus elevare; animarum & corporum
salutem ex singulari erga separatos amore se quærere;
multa commoda externa iisdem, sed revertentibus,
spondere; & qualiacunque illectamenta[?] proponere non
cessant, quò homines ad se alliciant, & ad subjectio-
nem sub sede Romanâ invitent. Adde varias Metho-
distarum artes, quibus hominum judicia quasi vertigine
quâdam corrumpere conantur. Quæ omnia quasi vi-
num scortationis referunt; quod si quis admittat, bi-
batque, is redit ad Meretricem Babylonicam, pristi-
namque cum eâ scortationem. Hujus philtri & toxici
vim experti sunt tot Principes, aliique homines parti-
cu-lares; quot cernimus post primam reformationis in-
trodu-

page.notes: The initial letter is an ornamental "I" joined to "N" in "IN serie". The word "illectamenta" is only partly legible in the scan; read as printed with [?]. Italic and roman type in "cognitionem gloriæ Christi" is uncertain. The word "Christi" may be roman, not italic. Small printer's dots appear between words ("philtri · &") and are not transcribed. Dot marks in the margins are not printed text.
